name: INARI
recent: Inari Amertron 公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收与净利双双增长，并宣布派发首次中期股息。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）与退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报股权变动。此外，公司因雇员认购 ESOS 期权而发行新股。
notable: 公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，净利升至 RM61 million，并宣布每股 1.5 仙的首次中期股息。
雇员公积金局（EPF）与退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报股权变动。
因雇员行使 ESOS 期权，公司发行约 306 万股新股，并于 11 月 13 日上市。
risks: 根据程序计算的财报数据，最新一季净利环比下降 78.0%，同比下滑 87.5%，净利率从上一季的 10.5% 降至 2.1%。
earnings: 根据程序计算的截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度数据，营收为 RM288.9 million，环比增长 8.7%，但同比下降 5.8%；净利为 RM6.1 million，环比下降 78.0%，同比下降 87.5%，净利率为 2.1%。

recent_en: Inari Amertron reported higher revenue and net profit for 1QFY2027 and declared a first interim dividend. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings between late October and mid-November. The company also issued new shares from ESOS option exercises.
notable_en: Announced 1QFY2027 results with net profit rising to RM61 million and declared a first interim dividend of 1.5 sen per share.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings between late October and mid-November.
Issued about 3.06 million new shares from ESOS option exercises, listed on 13 November.
risks_en: Based on the computed financial data, latest quarter net profit fell 78.0% QoQ and 87.5% YoY, with net margin dropping to 2.1% from 10.5% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: Based on the computed quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM288.9 million, up 8.7% QoQ but down 5.8% YoY; net profit was RM6.1 million, down 78.0% QoQ and 87.5% YoY, with a net margin of 2.1%.
